question: Write a function that Write a function that calculates gradient using a 3x3 window. This will be passed to the SciPy filter function below.
answer: def gradient(pixel_array, cell_w, cell_h): """Calculates gradient using a 3x3 window. pixel_array - 1D array containing the 9 pixel values, starting in the upper left and going left to right and down cell_w - pixel width in the same units as the data cell_h - pixel height in the same units as the data """ rise_val = ((pixel_array[6] + (2 * pixel_array[7]) + pixel_array[8]) - (pixel_array[0] + (2 * pixel_array[1]) + pixel_array[2])) / \ (8 * cell_h) run_val = ((pixel_array[2] + (2 * pixel_array[5]) + pixel_array[8]) - (pixel_array[0] + (2 * pixel_array[3]) + pixel_array[6])) / \ (8 * cell_w) dist_val = np.sqrt(np.square(rise_val) + np.square(run_val)) return np.arctan(dist_val) * 180 / np.pi
